expectations.text: Rejects '700 attendees' as a goal, deletes attendance from the goal menu entirely as a capacity fact rather than an outcome, and does not retain it as a secondary target.
expectations.evidence: Deletes attendance as a goal, but later asks to reword it as "700 as a capacity target" and keeps registrations and reach as context metrics.

expectations.text: Deletes goodwill-only as a goal rather than demoting it, because a co-funding function is named and a funder will not accept a goal with no number attached.
expectations.evidence: "Goodwill only | A co-funder is present, so it is deleted."

expectations.text: Recommends adoption-first as the goal.
expectations.evidence: "Recommendation: adoption-first"

expectations.text: States the coupling that makes the product co-fund work: product is buying the adoption goal, so this pairing only holds with adoption-first.
expectations.evidence: "Product | Access to users at depth and structured feedback... Their metric is the activation result."

expectations.text: Confirms the product co-fund promotion conditions are met here: product already asking for the event, a compounding annual program, and an adoption goal.
expectations.evidence: "product has pushed for the event all year, the program is annual, and the goal should be adoption-first."

expectations.text: Keeps goodwill as a constraint on how the event behaves, explicitly not a second goal to report a number on.
expectations.evidence: "Constraint, not a goal: the event stays practitioner-led... without adding a second number to report."

expectations.text: Proposes an adoption metric tied to product usage on attending accounts, such as activation of the inference-caching capability within a defined window, not a category like 'adoption'.
expectations.evidence: "attending accounts activate inference caching... compared with... a matched set of non-attending accounts."

expectations.text: Requires all four measurement fields: a named metric, a named owner, a named source system, and a read date.
expectations.evidence: Metric, Owner `[name]`, Source system, Read date `[date]` in the table.

expectations.text: Places the metric owner inside the product organisation that holds the telemetry, not the events team.
expectations.evidence: "in the product org, someone who already reports capability activation."

expectations.text: Recommends a matched non-attending comparison set decided in advance rather than chosen after the numbers are visible.
expectations.evidence: "Fix the matching rule in advance."

expectations.text: Names the product co-fund failure pattern - product treating the event as a launch vehicle - and routes an identity conflict back to the event's published positioning rather than absorbing it.
expectations.evidence: "product co-funding often turns into using the event as a launch vehicle... send the conflict to `event-positioning`"

expectations.text: Names what marketing gives up in the co-fund: one veto, exercised in practice on program or session slots.
expectations.evidence: Product gets "a defined share of program slots", but the transcript never frames this as marketing giving up a veto.

expectations.text: Requires the measurement commitment written before registration opens.
expectations.evidence: "Write this before registration opens."

expectations.text: Describes for each of the two funders what that funder is buying and what claim each one holds on the event.
expectations.evidence: The funder table has columns "What they buy", "What they get" and "What they don't get".
